info.description: REST API of go-ispconfig, the Go port of ISPConfig3. Authenticate via POST /api/login: browsers receive an HTTP-only session cookie (mutating requests then require the X-CSRF-Token header returned by login); non-browser clients present the same session id as a bearer token.
info.title: go-ispconfig API

get.description: The declarative descriptor table of every supported DNS record type (18 dns_rr types plus the TXT-derived SPF/DKIM/DMARC helper forms): stored type, name/data validation rules, aux usage and defaults. The Vue record editor renders its add/edit dialog from this metadata — the same source of truth the API validates against.

put.description: Merges the submitted fields over the stored dns_rr row, revalidates them against the per-type metadata and saves under the u-flag permission scope, bumping the SOA serial in the same transaction (unless update_serial=false) with datalog rows for both.

parameters.description: Changed field values plus the optional update_serial flag
parameters.name: record

delete.description: Removes the dns_rr row under the d-flag permission scope, journals the delete and bumps the SOA serial in the same transaction (unless ?update_serial=false).

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list of dns_slave zones with _datalog_state indicators.

post.description: Port of dns_slave_add: origin validated like a zone, ns is the required master IP list, xfer an optional IP list; the insert is journaled so the daemon configures the slave zone.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

get.description: The dns_template rows with visible = 'y', offered to every authenticated user by the zone wizard (port of the dns_wizard template list; admin CRUD lives at /dns/zone-templates).
Full dns_template CRUD list for administrators. Non-admins use GET /dns/templates for the visible wizard templates.

post.description: name required; fields is a CSV subset of DOMAIN,IP,IPV6,NS1,NS2,EMAIL,DKIM,DNSSEC; template holds the [ZONE]/[DNS_RECORDS] definition.

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list of dns_soa zones (port of dns_zone_get_by_user). Any declared field name may be passed as a query parameter for substring filtering (e.g. ?origin=example). Items carry _datalog_state ("pending"/"error") and _datalog_error while a change is being applied by the daemon or failed there.

post.description: Port of dns_zone_add: validates the dns_soa.tform rules (origin FQDN + unique + IDN/lowercase, ns/mbox formats, refresh/retry/expire/minimum/ttl >= 60, xfer/also_notify IP lists, DNS-capable server), sets the initial serial to <today>01, stamps ownership server-side and journals the insert to sys_datalog; the daemon then writes the zone. update_acl is accepted from admins only.

parameters.description: Field values (declared fields only; sys_ columns are ignored)
parameters.name: record

get.description: Resolves an origin (with or without trailing dot) to the id of an accessible zone (port of dns_zone_get_id). 404 when no accessible zone matches.

404.description: No accessible zone with this origin

post.description: Port of dns_templatezone_add: replaces the {DOMAIN}/{IP}/{IPV6}/{NS1}/{NS2}/{EMAIL} placeholders in the selected dns_template, parses its [ZONE]/[DNS_RECORDS] sections and creates the SOA plus all records plus their datalog rows in one transaction, with the initial serial <today>01. The DNSSEC flag injects dnssec_wanted=Y. Admins may assign the zone to a client group via client_group_id. Legacy ISPConfig3 templates expand unchanged.
post.summary: Create a zone from a template (wizard)

parameters.description: Template id and wizard field values
parameters.name: request

get.description: Returns the dns_soa record (port of dns_zone_get) including the daemon-written rendered_zone and dnssec_info columns, plus _datalog_state/_datalog_error while a change is pending or failed.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: Port of dns_zone_update: merges the declared body fields over the stored record, validates, bumps the SOA serial when any field changed (skippable with "update_serial": false in the body) and saves under the u-flag permission scope with a sys_datalog diff.

delete.description: Port of dns_zone_delete: removes the dns_soa row under the d-flag scope and journals the delete; the daemon then removes the zone file and its named.conf.local entry.

post.description: Port of dns_zone_set_dnssec: sets dnssec_wanted (Y/N) and optionally dnssec_algo, bumps the serial and journals the change; the daemon then runs the key/sign lifecycle.

get.description: All dns_rr rows of an accessible zone ordered by type then name (port of dns_rr_get_all_by_zone).
get.summary: List the records of a zone

post.description: Creates a dns_rr row of the given type (A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, CNAME, DNAME, DS, HINFO, LOC, MX, NAPTR, NS, PTR, RP, SRV, SSHFP, TLSA, TXT or the TXT-derived SPF/DKIM/DMARC helpers), validated by the per-type metadata. The record inherits the zone's server and ownership; the SOA serial is bumped in the same transaction unless update_serial=false, and datalog rows are journaled for the record and the SOA.
post.summary: Add a record to a zone

parameters.description: type, name, data, aux, ttl, active plus the optional update_serial flag
parameters.name: record

403.description: Zone not updatable by the caller

post.description: Port of dns_zone_set_status: sets dns_soa.active to Y/N, bumps the serial and journals the change; the daemon then adds/removes the zone from named.conf.local.

Verifies sys_user credentials (bcrypt or legacy ISPConfig3 crypt hashes) with brute-force lockout, creates a sys_session and returns the CSRF token and session id. The session id is also set as an HTTP-only cookie; non-browser clients may present it as a bearer token instead. With stay_logged_in the session lives 30 days (sliding) instead of the 1-hour idle TTL.
Deletes the current sys_session and clears the session cookie. Succeeds with 204 even without a valid session.

get.description: Returns the tabs, fields, types, defaults and validator hints of a registered entity so the SPA renders its form from the same source of truth used for validation. Admin-only tabs/fields are omitted for non-admin sessions.
Paginated, permission-scoped list. Any declared field name may be passed as a query parameter for substring filtering (e.g. ?ip_address=10.0).

post.description: Validates the declared fields (ip_address must be a unique valid IP), runs the client limit hook, stamps ownership server-side and journals the insert to sys_datalog.

parameters.description: Field values (declared fields only; sys_ columns are ignored)
parameters.name: record

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: Merges the declared body fields over the stored record, validates the result and saves it under the u-flag permission scope with a sys_datalog diff.

get.description: Returns the logged-in user: username, access level, effective groups, language and the session CSRF token (so a reloaded SPA can resume without logging in again).

Paginated, permission-scoped list of vhost/subdomain/alias domains. Any declared field name may be passed as a query parameter for substring filtering (e.g. ?domain=example). Items carry _datalog_state ("pending"/"error") and _datalog_error while a change is being applied by the daemon or failed there.

post.description: Validates the tform-ported field rules (domain syntax/uniqueness, quotas, nginx_directives blacklist), derives document_root, system_user and system_group server-side (ISPConfig onAfterInsert semantics) and journals the insert to sys_datalog in the same transaction; the daemon then provisions the site. Admin-only Options fields are ignored for non-admin callers.

parameters.description: Field values (declared fields only; sys_ columns are ignored)
parameters.name: record

get.description: Returns the record plus _datalog_state/_datalog_error when the daemon has not yet applied (or failed to apply) the latest change.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: Merges the declared body fields over the stored record, validates the result and saves it under the u-flag permission scope with a sys_datalog diff consumed by the daemon.

204.description: Deleted (vhost/pool/dirs removed asynchronously by the daemon)

post.description: The plaintext password is stored SHA-512 crypted (never plain); the daemon copies the hash into the folder's .htpasswd file. server_id is derived from the referenced folder, which must be readable by the caller.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

parameters.description: Changed field values (a plaintext password is re-crypted)
parameters.name: record

post.description: server_id is derived from the referenced parent domain, which must be readable by the caller (cross-client references are denied). The daemon maintains the .htpasswd file and the auth_basic vhost location.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

post.description: Logs into the legacy ISPConfig3 remote JSON API with the given remote_user, verifies every required *_get grant and returns the legacy server list. Credentials are held only in server memory for the wizard session — never stored, logged or echoed. Admin only.

400.description: Login fault, missing grants or TLS/certificate error

post.description: Classifies every legacy record as create/update/skip-identical/conflict against the local database, without writing anything. Returns per-entity counts, the full conflict list with reasons and the password-reset user list. Admin only.

409.description: Not connected or a run is active

post.description: Re-fetches the legacy snapshot, rebuilds the plan and applies it in a background goroutine (progress via SSE/status; the run survives page reloads). A multi-server legacy panel is rejected unless confirm_map_all_to_local_server is set. One run at a time. Admin only.

parameters.description: Selection, target server and multi-server confirmation
parameters.name: request

400.description: Multi-server without confirmation, or planning failed

409.description: Not connected or a run is already active

get.description: Fetches everything the import needs from the legacy panel (read-only) and returns the per-entity counts, the legacy server list and the multi-server guard flag. Admin only.

409.description: Not connected or a run is active

get.description: Server-sent events stream: first the current status snapshot, then one event per apply progress step ({entity,done,total}) and a final status event when the run finishes or fails. Use the status endpoint as a polling fallback. Admin only.

post.description: Generates one one-time reset token per panel user recreated by the finished run (their imported password is an unusable placeholder). The cleartext tokens appear only in this response; the database stores digests. Admin only.

409.description: No finished run with reset-required users

get.description: Returns the wizard state machine snapshot (state, inventory, per-entity progress, error, final report). Polling this endpoint is the documented fallback for proxies that buffer SSE. Admin only.
Lists the daemon scheduler jobs with their last-run time and status, read from the sys_config "scheduler" mirror the daemon persists after every job execution. Admin only.

aux_default.description: AuxDefault is the default aux value.

aux_label.description: AuxLabel is the i18n label key of the aux input (priority).

aux_used.description: AuxUsed marks types whose aux column is meaningful (MX/SRV/NAPTR).

data_kind.description: DataKind selects the data check: "ipv4", "ipv6" or "text".

data_label.description: DataLabel is the i18n label key of the data input.

data_not_contains.description:
DataNotContains rejects data containing any of these substrings
(plain TXT refuses DKIM/DMARC/SPF payloads — dedicated forms exist).

data_prefix.description: DataPrefix requires the data to start with this string (SPF/DMARC).

data_regex.description: DataRegex additionally validates textual data when set.

name_regex.description: NameRegex validates the record name (Go regex, exported for the UI).

name_required.description: NameRequired marks types whose name must not be empty.

stored_type.description: StoredType is the dns_rr.type enum value written to the DB.

type.description:
Type is the API discriminator (A, MX, ... plus the TXT-derived
SPF/DKIM/DMARC helper forms).

fields.description:
Fields is the CSV of wizard inputs the template declares
(DOMAIN,IP,IPV6,NS1,NS2,EMAIL,DKIM,DNSSEC).

client_group_id.description:
ClientGroupID optionally assigns the zone to a client group
(admin only).

dnssec.description: DNSSEC injects dnssec_wanted=Y into the [ZONE] section.

server_id.description:
ServerID optionally selects the DNS server; the first dns_server=1
server is used when omitted.

dnssec_algo.description:
Algo optionally replaces dnssec_algo (CSV subset of
NSEC3RSASHA1/ECDSAP256SHA256).

id.description: ID is the dns_soa primary key.

fields.description:
Fields maps field names to their i18n validation error keys
(422 responses only).

key.description: Key is the i18n message key describing the error.

datatype.description: Datatype is the tform datatype (INTEGER, VARCHAR, ...).

default.description: Default is the value applied when a create omits the field.

formtype.description: Formtype is the original tform form control name.

label.description: Label is the i18n label key.

name.description: Name is the DB column and JSON key of the field.

options.description: Options lists the allowed values of select/checkbox fields.

type.description:
Type is the SPA control type (text, password, textarea, select,
checkbox), derived from the tform formtype.

validators.description: Validators are the declarative rules the API enforces.

title.description: Title is the i18n title key of the form.

fields.description: Fields are the fields rendered on the tab.

label.description: Label is the i18n label key.

items.description: Items are the records of the requested page, keyed by DB column.

limit.description: Limit is the applied page size.

page.description: Page is the returned 1-based page number.

total.description: Total is the number of records matching the filters (all pages).

stay_logged_in.description:
StayLoggedIn requests a long-lived session (30 days sliding
expiration, sys_session.permanent) instead of the 1-hour idle TTL.

username.description: Username is the sys_user login name.

csrf_token.description:
CSRFToken must be sent as X-CSRF-Token on every mutating
cookie-authenticated request.

session_id.description:
SessionID is the session id, also set as the HTTP-only cookie.
Non-browser clients present it as "Authorization: Bearer <id>".

typ.description: Typ is the access level ("admin" or "user").

username.description: Username is the authenticated login name.

insecure.description: Insecure disables TLS certificate verification (echoed as a warning).

password.description: Password is the legacy remote_user password.

url.description: URL is the legacy panel base URL.

username.description: Username is the legacy remote_user name.

insecure.description: Insecure echoes that TLS verification is disabled.

multi_server.description:
MultiServer flags more than one legacy server (execute will require
explicit confirmation).

plain_http.description: PlainHTTP echoes an unencrypted panel URL.

servers.description: Servers is the legacy server list.

fault_code.description:
FaultCode is the legacy fault code, when the legacy panel answered
with a fault.

missing_functions.description: MissingFunctions lists remote functions the remote_user lacks.

conflicts.description: Conflicts lists every conflicting record with its reason.

counts.description: Counts is the per-table create/update/skip/conflict tally.

reset_required.description: ResetRequired lists panel users that will need a password reset.

assign_orphan_zones_to_admin.description: AssignOrphanZonesToAdmin assigns zones with absent owners to admin.

confirm_map_all_to_local_server.description:
ConfirmMapAllToLocalServer explicitly confirms mapping a
multi-server legacy panel onto the single local server (execute
only).

selection.description: Selection is the entity subset (empty = everything).

target_server_id.description:
TargetServerID maps every legacy server_id; 0 uses the first local
server.

sites.description: Sites selects web domain/folder/folder user import.

error.description: Error is the failure message of a failed run.

inventory.description: Inventory is the last fetched inventory.

legacy_url.description: LegacyURL is the connected panel URL (no credentials).

multi_server.description: MultiServer flags a multi-server legacy panel.

plain_http.description: PlainHTTP echoes an unencrypted panel URL.

progress.description: Progress is the per-entity apply progress.

report.description: Report is the final report of a finished run.

state.description: State is the wizard state machine position.

label.description: Label is the i18n label key of the option.

last_run.description: LastRun is the RFC3339 time of the last execution, empty if never run.

status.description: Status is "ok" or "error: <message>" from the last execution.

csrf_token.description:
CSRFToken is the per-session token for the X-CSRF-Token header, so a
reloaded SPA can recover it without logging in again.

groups.description: Groups is the effective sys_group id list of the user.

language.description: Language is the panel language of the user.

typ.description: Typ is the access level ("admin" or "user").

username.description: Username is the sys_user login name.

clients.description: Clients is the legacy client count.

dns_records.description: DNSRecords counts dns_rr records across all zones.

multi_server.description:
MultiServer flags a legacy panel with more than one server: the run
must be blocked until the operator explicitly confirms mapping
everything onto the single local server (design D3 guard).

servers.description: Servers is the legacy server list (server_id, server_name rows).

web_domains.description: WebDomains counts web_domain records of all imported types.

key.description: Key is the natural key, for display and reports.

legacy_id.description:
LegacyID is the legacy primary key (for sys_user/sys_group items it
is the legacy client id they are derived from).

reason.description: Reason names the conflict cause (conflict items only).

table.description: Table is the local table the record belongs to.

done.description: Done counts processed items of the entity.

entity.description: Entity is the local table being applied.

total.description: Total is the entity's item count in the plan.

conflicts.description: Conflicts lists every conflicting record with its reason.

counts.description: Counts is the per-table created/updated/skipped/conflict tally.

operational_order.description: OperationalOrder states the mandatory post-import sequence.

reset_required.description:
ResetRequired lists panel users created with an unusable password;
the bulk reset flow issues their one-time tokens.

rsync_suggestions.description:
RsyncSuggestions is one suggested command per imported vhost for
transferring site files (file transfer itself is out of scope),
including uid/gid remapping.

warnings.description:
Warnings collects everything the operator must not miss: insecure
transport, multi-server mapping, SSL re-issue, orphan assignments.

token.description: Token is the one-time reset token (cleartext, never stored).

username.description: Username is the panel login the token belongs to.

dnssecinitialized.description:
DNSSECInitialized is daemon-managed; the default tag keeps a zero
value out of API inserts (the column is a strict-mode enum).

trafficQuotaLock.description:
default tag: not a form field; the DB default 'n' must apply on
insert (a zero-value "" would fail the NOT NULL enum in strict mode).

allow_empty.description:
AllowEmpty skips the check for empty values (tform allowempty 'y';
honored by UNIQUE, ISEMAIL, ISINT, ISPOSITIVE and ISIP). Without it,
an empty value fails those checks — a numeric rule must never be
silently satisfied by an absent value.

errmsg.description: ErrKey is the i18n message key reported on failure (tform errmsg).

regex.description: Regex is the pattern of a REGEX rule (Go syntax).

type.description:
Type is the validator name: REGEX, UNIQUE, NOTEMPTY, ISEMAIL, ISINT,
ISPOSITIVE, ISIPV4, ISIPV6, ISIP or CUSTOM.

BearerAuth.description: Session id as bearer token: "Bearer <session id>". No CSRF token required on this transport.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

CookieAuth.description: Browser transport: goisp_session HTTP-only cookie set by POST /api/login. Mutating requests must also send the X-CSRF-Token header.
CookieAuth.name: Cookie
